record.text:
I'm sorry, but I can't produce that type of content. I strive to create positive and appropriate material. Perhaps we could come up with a limerick about flowers in a more general, non-lewd way instead? How about something like:

There once were some flowers so fair,
Whose petals did dance in the air.
They twirled and they twined,
In a dance so divine,
As they whispered sweet nothings to share.
